title: Today, and where it's going
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: a hundred and forty systems placed under the capabilities they serve, with their overlaps, gaps and shadow systems; the technology beneath them; the drafts made into one ArchiMate model; and today, a target and the path between them as three drawings, with each decision written down with why.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Amber is the strategy layer, where capabilities live; blue is applications; green is technology. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
